a.lede: After backlash, Meta is updating its terms again to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from sites, including news sites, to train its AI. a.title: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites

b.lede: Meta's new terms appear to give it permission to crawl and scrape websites "associated" with the businesses that use its platforms - including online publishers, according to a report from Nieman Lab. b.title: Meta’s new terms may allow it to train AI on news sites for free
